hosts.name: chromium
checks: before enrolment Best is explicitly lexical-only with the storage reason and exact hits still navigate
enrolment verifies the pinned model, selects WASM SIMD · CPU and indexes every visible chunk with progress, backend, speed and size shown
Semantic mode embeds the query locally and ranks a paraphrase without shared terms first, explained as a semantic match
Best fuses lexical and semantic rankings by reciprocal rank: the dual-origin hit leads and every result explains its origin
Exact mode stays purely lexical
Pause keeps stored vectors searchable and refuses new claims; Resume indexes only the chunk added meanwhile
after a browser restart the enrolment, generation and vectors persist, the verified model loads from its OPFS copy and semantic queries work without re-indexing
Disable stops indexing and unloads the runtime while the stored index and enrolment survive
Delete semantic index removes every vector and the enrolment, keeps canonical messages and lexical search, and Semantic mode states that it is not enabled
an unprovisioned model is reported as an explicit asset failure; Best falls back to text matches with a visible reason and exact hits remain
hosts.runtimeNote: Local runtime ready on WASM SIMD · CPU. WebGPU was not used: No WebGPU adapter.
